1.text: Uwo munsi uzavuga uti “Uwiteka, ndagushimira yuko nubwo wandakariraga, uburakari bwawe bushize ukampumuriza.

2.text: Dore Imana ni yo gakiza kanjye nzajya niringira ne gutinya, kuko Uwiteka Yehova ari we mbaraga zanjye n'indirimbo yanjye agahinduka agakiza kanjye.”

3.text: Ni cyo gituma muzavomana ibyishimo mu mariba y'agakiza.

4.text: Kandi uwo munsi muzavuga muti “Nimushime Uwiteka mwambaze izina rye, mwamamaze imirimo ye mu mahanga, muvuge yuko izina rye rishyizwe hejuru.

5.text: Muririmbire Uwiteka kuko yakoze ibihebuje byose, ibyo nibyamamare mu isi yose.

6.text: Wa muturage w'i Siyoni we, shyira ejuru uvuge cyane, kuko Uwera wa Isirayeli uri hagati yawe akomeye.”
